1.title: Move green cube to right tray
1.say: Pick up the green cube from the left tray. Place it inside the right tray.
placements: green small cube → inside the right clear grid on the table to the right of the left grid as seen from above, placed with the white robot arm using the thin sucking tip on top of the cube (in the video: near the bottom edge by the black cable side)
watch_for: if the green cube is still in the left tray, the tip did not suck it up
if the green cube sits outside the clear squares, it slipped off while moving
1.check_yourself: It should look like the green cube sits inside the right clear grid as seen from above.
1.safety: Keep your fingers well away from the moving robot arm.
